overview: In the morning the seal was still on the letter. You had a mind to take out the word live, and you left it. You wrote that the sentence can stand till the eleventh, and that the Verona papers stay shut.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Left the word in, and left the papers shut.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Is still the person on the outside of the sheet. Not present.
